blocks.head: alt Either user invites the other user
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserX has key and the device exists
alt Any existing UserX and Device
alt UserY is a member of UserX in the cloud

state_rules.rule:
eq < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'invite' Cloud | (UserY) 
= < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > 
= < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : Members , 'device' : Device , ..) , UserY : ('device' : Device , ...) , ....) > .

eq < Cloud | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < Device | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ UserX 'requestKey' Cloud | (Device) 
= < Cloud | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < Device | ('key' : Key , ....) > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key) .

eq < UserX | ('key' : nils , ..) > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('key' : UserKey , ..) > $ Cloud 'sendKey' UserX | (Device ; Key) 
= < UserX | ('key' : UserKey , ..) > .

eq < Device | ('key' : Key , 'on' : false , ..) > $ UserX 'turnOn' Device | (Key) 
= < Device | ('key' : Key , 'on' : true , ..) > .

eq < Cloud | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < Device | ('on' : false , ....) > $ UserX 'cloudTurnOn' Cloud | (Device) 
= < Cloud | (UserX : ('device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < Device | ('on' : true , ....) > .

eq < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Members) , ..) , UserY : ('device' : Device , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'removeMember' Cloud | (UserY) 
= < Cloud | (UserX : ('members' : Members , ..) , UserY : ('device' : nils , ...) , ....) > .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudB | (....) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX, cloudB, UserY) @ S < UserX | (..) > < UserY | (...) > < cloudB | (....) > .

event_rules.label: rev2
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev2]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceB | (...) > < cloudB | (....) > 
=> ep: ev2(UserX, cloudB, deviceB) @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceB | (...) > < cloudB | (....) > .

event_rules.label: rev3
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev3]: E @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ...) > 
=> ep: ev3(UserX, deviceB, Key) @ S < UserX | ('key' : Key , ..) > < deviceB | ('key' : Key , ...) > .

event_rules.label: rev4

rl [rev4]: E @ S < UserX | (..) > < deviceB | (...) > < cloudB | (....) >

event_rules.label: rev5
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev5]: E @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > < UserY | (.....) > 
=> ep: ev5(UserX, cloudB, UserY) @ S < cloudB | (UserX : ('members' : (UserY , Rest) , 'device' : Device , ..) , ...) > < UserX | (....) > < UserY | (.....) > .
